versions.content: Service Name Dem_SetEventConfirmationThresholdCounter Syntax Std_ReturnType Dem_SetEventConfirmationThresholdCounter ( Dem_EventIdType EventId, uint8 FailureCycleCounterThreshold ) Service ID [hex] 0x57 5 236 of 535 Document ID 19: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticEventManager Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 4 Sync/Async Asynchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different EventIds. Non reentrant for the same EventId. EventId Identification of an event by assigned EventId. Parameters (in) FailureCycleCounter Threshold Failure cycle counter threshold of event to be set. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Change of threshold was successful. E_NOT_OK: Threshold cannot be changed as DemEvent ConfirmationThresholdCounterAdaptable is set to FALSE for this event. Description Set the failure confirmation threshold of an event. Available via Dem.h
